storyline.governing_thought: Each statement slide is judged on what it is trying to be

eval.purpose: Archetype battery (statement): short / long / with and without support / Spanish / quote-like

slides.text: Price is not the problem; availability is
We should exit the wholesale business by 2027
slides.support: It uses 30% of capital and earns 4% of profit.

slides.text: Three of our five markets will shrink in the next decade, and the two that grow are the ones where we are weakest today
slides.support: This document explains how we rebalance the portfolio without losing scale.

slides.text: La decisión es sencilla: invertir ahora o perder la licencia
slides.support: El regulador revisa las concesiones en 2027.

slides.text: “Customers do not leave because of price; they leave because nobody calls back”
Recomendamos no renovar el contrato con el operador logístico actual

slides.support: Services were 12% of revenue in 2020 and are 31% today; hardware shrank every year.
Approve €14M for the pilot in four regions; results come back to the board in nine months.

slides.text: El 80% del ahorro depende de una sola palanca: renegociar la energía
slides.support: El resto de iniciativas suma menos de 6 M€ y puede esperar al segundo año.
